His whole life was a benefit to all who were connected with him.

7807-georgina-of-the-rainbows.creator: Unknown
7807-georgina-of-the-rainbows.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. She was in her high-chair by a window overlooking a gray sea, and with a bib under her chin, was being fed dripping spoonfuls of bread and milk from the silver porringer which rested on the sill.

arxiv-1409-0175.title: Study of formality for the Heisenberg algebra
arxiv-1409-0175.creator: Olivier Elchinger
arxiv-1409-0175.description: Abstract In this paper, we compute the Chevalley-Eilenberg cohomology of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra with values in its universal enveloping algebra. We also compute the Schouten brackets on cochains and cohomology level in order to write the formality equations.

arxiv-2103-02353.creator: T. N. Shorey and Sneh Bala Sinha
arxiv-2103-02353.description: Abstract . We consider the irreducibility of polynomial L n ( α ) ​ ( x ) L_{n}^{(\alpha)}(x) where α \alpha is a negative integer. We observe that the constant term of L n ( α ) ​ ( x ) L_{n}^{(\alpha)}(x) vanishes if and only if n ≥ | α | = − α n\geq|\alpha|=-\alpha .

arxiv-2103-11384.title: Hierarchical Representation based Query-Specific Prototypical Network for Few-Shot Image Classification
arxiv-2103-11384.creator: Yaohui Li, Huaxiong Li, Haoxing Chen, Chunlin Chen
arxiv-2103-11384.description: Abstract Few-shot image classification aims at recognizing unseen categories with a small number of labeled training data. Recent metric-based frameworks tend to represent a support class by a fixed prototype (e.g., the mean of the support category) and make classification according to the similarities between query instances and support prototypes.

arxiv-2103-15803.title: Partially Observable Szilárd Engines
arxiv-2103-15803.creator: Susanne Still, Dorian Daimer
arxiv-2103-15803.description: Abstract Almost a century ago, Leo Szilárd replaced Maxwell’s “demon” by machinery. The resulting information engine concept laid the foundation for studying the physical nature of information. Szilárd reduced the demon’s role to mapping an observable onto a work extraction protocol, thereby creating and utilizing a meta-stable memory.

arxiv-2310-12228.title: Solution to the conflict between the resolved and unresolved galaxy stellar mass estimation from the perspective of JWST
arxiv-2310-12228.creator: Jie Song, GuanWen Fang, Zesen Lin, Yizhou Gu, Xu Kong
arxiv-2310-12228.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jie Song, GuanWen Fang, Zesen Lin, Yizhou Gu, Xu Kong. By utilizing the spatially-resolved photometry of galaxies at 0.2 < z < 3.0 0.2<z<3.0 in the CEERS field, we estimate the resolved and unresolved stellar mass via spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting to study the discrepancy between them. We first compare M ∗ M_{\ast} derived from photometry with and without the JWST wavelength coverage and find that M ∗ M_{\ast} can be overestimated by up to 0.2 dex when lacking rest-frame NIR data.

arxiv-2405-11512.title: Going into Orbit: Massively Parallelizing Episodic Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2405-11512.creator: Johann Bonneau, Jan Oberst
arxiv-2405-11512.description: Abstract The possibilities of robot control have multiplied across various domains through the application of deep reinforcement learning. To overcome safety and sampling efficiency issues, deep reinforcement learning models can be trained in a simulation environment, allowing for faster iteration cycles. This can be enhanced further by parallelizing the training process using GPUs.

arxiv-2407-12098.title: Boundary fractional Hardy’s inequality in dimension one: The critical case
arxiv-2407-12098.creator: Adimurthi, Purbita Jana, Prosenjit Roy
arxiv-2407-12098.description: Abstract . We prove fractional boundary Hardy’s inequality in dimension one for the critical case s ​ p = 1 sp=1 . Optimality of the inequality is obtained for any p p . The extra logarithmic correction term appears in usual fashion.

arxiv-2408-15805.title: Investigating Complex HPV Dynamics Using Emulation and History Matching
arxiv-2408-15805.creator: Andrew Iskauskas, Jamie A. Cohen, Danny Scarponi, Ian Vernon, Michael Goldstein, Daniel Klein, Richard G. White, Nicky McCreesh
arxiv-2408-15805.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andrew Iskauskas, Jamie A. Cohen, Danny Scarponi, Ian Vernon, Michael Goldstein, Daniel Klein, Richard G. White, Nicky McCreesh. The study of transmission and progression of human papillomavirus (HPV) is crucial for understanding the incidence of cervical cancers, and has been identified as a priority worldwide. The complexity of the disease necessitates a detailed model of HPV transmission and its progression to cancer; to infer properties of the above we require a careful process that can match to imperfect or incomplete observational data.

arxiv-2409-04950.title: Boundary accumulations of active rods in microchannels with elliptical cross-section
arxiv-2409-04950.creator: Chase Brown, Shawn D. Ryan, Mykhailo Potomkin
arxiv-2409-04950.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chase Brown, Shawn D. Ryan, Mykhailo Potomkin. Many motile microorganisms and bio-mimetic micro-particles have been successfully modeled as active rods - elongated bodies capable of self-propulsion. A hallmark of active rod dynamics under confinement is their tendency to accumulate at the walls. Unlike passive particles, which typically sediment and cease their motion at the wall, accumulated active rods continue to move along the wall, reorient, and may even escape from it.

arxiv-2409-17200.title: A random measure approach to reinforcement learning in continuous time
arxiv-2409-17200.creator: Christian Bender 1, Nguyen Tran Thuan 1,2
arxiv-2409-17200.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Christian Bender 1, Nguyen Tran Thuan 1,2. We present a random measure approach for modeling exploration, i.e., the execution of measure-valued controls, in continuous-time reinforcement learning (RL) with controlled diffusion and jumps. First, we consider the case when sampling the randomized control in continuous time takes place on a discrete-time grid and reformulate the resulting stochastic differential equation (SDE) as an equation driven by suitable random measures.

arxiv-2506-00646.title: F F -injectivity does not imply F F -fullness in normal domains
arxiv-2506-00646.creator: Alessandro De Stefani, Thomas Polstra, Austyn Simpson
arxiv-2506-00646.description: Abstract . We construct examples of noetherian three-dimensional local geometrically normal domains of prime characteristic which are F F -injective but not F F -full. Along the way, we find examples of two-dimensional local geometrically normal domains which are F F -injective but not F F -anti-nilpotent.

arxiv-2509-06852.title: Using Erdős’s methods to study Yorke’s problems
arxiv-2509-06852.creator: Eran Igra and Valerii Sopin
arxiv-2509-06852.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the possible bifurcations of periodic orbits by reducing them to graphs. The aforementioned allows to study the genericity of routes to chaos, as well as to analyze their possible complexity. In particular, our results show that there is no upper bound on the possible complexity for dimension d > 3 d>3 .

arxiv-2602-17753.title: The 2025 AI Agent Index Documenting Technical and Safety Features of Deployed Agentic AI Systems
arxiv-2602-17753.creator: Leon Staufer, Kevin Feng, Kevin Wei, Luke Bailey, Yawen Duan, Mick Yang, A. Pinar Ozisik, Stephen Casper, Noam Kolt
arxiv-2602-17753.description: Abstract . Agentic AI systems are increasingly capable of performing professional and personal tasks with limited human involvement. However, tracking these developments is difficult because the AI agent ecosystem is complex, rapidly evolving, and inconsistently documented, posing obstacles to both researchers and policymakers. To address these challenges, this paper presents the 2025 AI Agent Index.

britannica-1911-geraldton.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-geraldton.description: Article 'Geraldton' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 11), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. on Champion Bay, 306 m. It is the seat of a Roman Catholic bishop, an important seaport carrying on a considerable trade with the surrounding gold-fields and agricultural districts, the centre of a considerable railway system and an increasingly popular seaside resort. The harbour is safe and extensive, having a pier affording accommodation for large steamers.

pmc-10650109.title: Proteomic Analyses of the G Protein-Coupled Estrogen Receptor GPER1 Reveal Constitutive Links to Endoplasmic Reticulum, Glycosylation, Trafficking, and Calcium Signaling
pmc-10650109.creator: Maryam Ahmadian Elmi, Nasrin Motamed, Didier Picard
pmc-10650109.description: The G protein-coupled estrogen receptor 1 (GPER1) has been proposed to mediate rapid responses to the steroid hormone estrogen. However, despite a strong interest in its potential role in cancer, whether it is indeed activated by estrogen and how this works remain controversial.

pmc-11266484.title: A high-performance sub-THz planar antenna array for THz sensing and imaging applications
pmc-11266484.creator: Muhammad Zubair, Abdul Jabbar, Farooq A. Tahir, Jalil ur Rehman Kazim, Masood Ur Rehman, Muhammad Imran, Bo Liu, Qammer H. Abbasi
pmc-11266484.description: Terahertz (THz) spectral region from 0.1 to 3 THz is envisaged to hold immense potential in the next generation of wireless technologies. Recently, research has focused on this terahertz gap, because of its unprecedented channel capacities. At the physical layer, the design complexities and fabrication of THz devices, especially antennas are the prime bottlenecks to realize its full potential.

pmc-11293413.title: Profile of Sport and Exercise Physician trainee’s clinical practice within Australasia in 2019: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11293413.creator: Christopher Lim, Brett Vaughan, Kylie Fitzgerald, Jane Fitzpatrick
pmc-11293413.description: ObjectiveTo identify the patient population profile and the spectrum of training activities and influencing factors of Australasian College of Sport and Exercise Physician (ACSEP) trainees.DesignRetrospective cross-sectional design.SettingTraining settings for ACSEP trainees.ParticipantsTwenty ACSEP trainees undertaking full-time training in training period 2 of the 2019 training year (1 August 2019–31 January 2020).

pmc-11356963.title: Developing Photoactive Coumarin-Caged N-Hydroxysulfonamides for Generation of Nitroxyl (HNO)
pmc-11356963.creator: Mohammad S Rahman, Vinay Bharadwaj, Anau K H S Lautaha, Paul Sampson, Nicola E Brasch, Alexander J Seed, Janina Kabatc-Borcz
pmc-11356963.description: Photoactive N-hydroxysulfonamides photocaged with the (6-bromo-7-hydroxycoumarin-4-yl)methyl chromophore have been successfully synthesized, and the mechanisms of photodecomposition investigated for two of the compounds. Upon irradiation up to 97% of a diagnostic marker for (H)NO release, sulfinate was observed for the trifluoromethanesulfonamide system.

pmc-11574617.title: T-cell and Soluble Co-inhibitory Receptor Expression in Patients With Visceral Leishmaniasis Are Markers of Treatment Response and Clinical Outcome
pmc-11574617.creator: Muluneh Ademe, Yaneth Osorio, Helina Fikre, Desalegn Adane, Tadele Mulaw, Bruno L Travi, Rawliegh Howe, Asrat Hailu, Tamrat Abebe, Peter C Melby
pmc-11574617.description: BackgroundCo-inhibitory receptors (immune checkpoints) regulate activated immune cells. Their expression on T cells can limit host defense. We hypothesized that chronic Leishmania donovani infection in patients with visceral leishmaniasis (VL) leads to expression of co-inhibitory receptors that could be markers of treatment response and clinical outcome.

pmc-11970136.title: The effectiveness of COVID-19 Heterologous Vaccination: the experience from a Regional Hospital in Cameroon
pmc-11970136.creator: Princewill Kum Unji, Alex Mambap Tatang, Samuel Angwafor, Loveline Lum Niba, Adji Minette Jaqueline Porro, Denis Nsame Nforniwe, Andreas Chiabi
pmc-11970136.description: BackgroundWith most COVID-19 vaccines requiring at least 2 doses, heterologous vaccination will facilitate vaccination programs where vaccine supplies fluctuate. However, with insufficient data on effects of heterologous vaccination in our setting, people remain reluctant to mix.ObjectivesWe seek to assess the effects of heterologous vaccination on morbidity and mortality.

pmc-12656260.title: Solvent-Free Synthesis of P(MMA-AA) Copolymers and Their Application as Sustainable Primers for Concrete Substrates
pmc-12656260.creator: Aisha Nurlybayeva, Zhansaya Urkimbayeva, Raikhan Rakhmetullayeva, Raushan Taubayeva, Nurbanu Sarova, Ainur Seitkan, Gulnaziya Seitbekova, Kamila Bulekbayeva, Bakytgul Kussainova, Assem Shinibekova, Rustem Ergali
pmc-12656260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study reports the solvent-free synthesis, structural characterization, and performance evaluation of poly (methyl methacrylate-co-acrylic acid) [P(MMA-AA)] copolymers intended for use as sustainable concrete primers and industrial coatings. A series of copolymers with varying MMA-AA molar ratios were synthesized via bulk radical polymerization and characterized using 1H and 13C nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC). The resulting materials were evaluated for their physical mechanical properties, including viscosity, tensile strength, surface hardness, and wettability.

pmc-12663602.title: Post‐operative recovery of quality‐of‐life following percutaneous nephrolithotomy: The impact on pain intensity and interference and the ability to participate in social roles
pmc-12663602.creator: Justin B Ziemba, Amanda Jones, Hanna Stambakio, Gregory E Tasian, Jing Huang
pmc-12663602.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivesTo prospectively capture patient‐reported outcomes in the post‐operative period to better understand the quality‐of‐life impact of percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PNL).Subjects and MethodsAdults undergoing PNL for renal/ureteral stones were eligible for inclusion (11/2020–8/2022). Patients prospectively completed PROMIS – Pain Intensity, Pain Interference and Ability to participate in social roles and activities in‐person pre‐operatively (POD 0) and via email on POD 1, 7, 14 and 30.

pmc-12731185.title: Utility of Tumor Suppressor E2F Target Gene Promoter Elements to Drive Gene Expression Specifically in Cancer Cells
pmc-12731185.creator: Kenta Kurayoshi, Masakazu Tanaka, Rinka Nakajima, Yaxuan Zhou, Mashiro Shirasawa, Mariana Fikriyanti, Jun-ichi Fujisawa, Ritsuko Iwanaga, Andrew P. Bradford, Keigo Araki, Kiyoshi Ohtani
pmc-12731185.description: The transcription factor E2F is the principal target of the tumor suppressor pRB. In almost all cancers, pRB function is disabled due to oncogenic changes, leading to enhanced E2F activity, thereby facilitating aberrant cell proliferation. Enhanced E2F activity has been utilized to drive gene expression preferentially in cancer cells using E2F target promoters, such as the E2F1 promoter.

pmc-13055716.title: Specific Features of Cerebral Venous Thrombosis Associated With Iron Deficiency Anemia
pmc-13055716.creator: Diana Doukhi, Agnes Aghetti, Virginie Siguret, Julien Labreuche, Maxime Delrue, Peggy Reiner, Georges Jourdi, Ludovic Drouet, Eric Jouvent, Mikael Mazighi, Isabelle Crassard
pmc-13055716.description: BackgroundAnemia has emerged as a risk factor for cerebral venous thrombosis (CVT) and has been associated with poorer outcomes. A specific association has been observed with microcytic anemia, most commonly caused by iron deficiency anemia (IDA). However, detailed data on the clinical, radiological, and therapeutic profile of CVT in patients with IDA remain limited.

pmc-13147257.title: Unexpected therapeutic scenarios: initiating SGLT2 inhibitors in de novo heart failure without echocardiography
pmc-13147257.creator: Luca Antonio Felice Di Odoardo, Emilia D’Elia, Edoardo Sciatti, Ottavio Zucchetti, Luca Fazzini, Salvatore D’Isa, Michele Senni
pmc-13147257.description: In the field of heart failure, sodium–glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2-i) have demonstrated robust efficacy and have received a Class I, Level A recommendation for reducing the risk of heart failure hospitalizations and cardiovascular mortality across the entire spectrum of left ventricular ejection fraction.

pmc-13446099.title: Microwave and solvent extraction of Opuntia cladode mucilage: Functional characterization and application as natural hydrocolloid substitute for egg yolk in mayonnaise

pmc-13581952.title: Case Report: Left ventricular pseudoaneurysm presenting with ventricular tachycardia
pmc-13581952.creator: Esra Polat, Mahmut Arslan, Yusuf Çorbacıoğlu, Ahmet Khalousi, Rauf Önder, Candan Güngör
pmc-13581952.description: Left ventricular pseudoaneurysm is a rare and life-threatening disorder that can present with a wide range of clinical manifestations, from an asymptomatic disease to sudden cardiac death. This case report presents a 38-year-old patient with no history of cardiovascular disease who presented with ventricular tachycardia and was diagnosed with left ventricular pseudoaneurysm following multiple cardiac imaging investigations.
